name: rfc8032-7-1
description: Ed25519 keypair pinned to RFC 8032 §7.1 Test 1. Canonical agent signing keypair shared across this suite, the Envoys signature/v1 §14 reproducible vectors, and the aps-conformance-suite composition fixtures, so verifiers can demonstrate byte-match parity across implementations. The encoded forms below are all derivations of the same 32-byte public key and 32-byte private seed; the generator recomputes them from the seed on every run.
warning: These keys are published in RFC 8032 itself and are for cross-implementation verification only. They MUST NOT be used to sign anything in any production deployment.
